[
  {
    "clause_id": "k1",
    "rule_id": "R01",
    "verdict": "compliant",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "evidence": "This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the substantive laws applicable within the jurisdiction of our principal headquarters.",
    "reason": "This governing law clause does not regulate or restrict personal data processing or consent."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k3",
    "rule_id": "R05",
    "verdict": "compliant",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "evidence": "All intellectual property rights, including trademarks, source code, graphics, and proprietary software, remain the sole and exclusive property of Al-Noor Digital Services.",
    "reason": "This clause deals strictly with intellectual property and does not affect data subject rights."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k4",
    "rule_id": "R02",
    "verdict": "compliant",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "evidence": "For the purposes of this document, the term Service shall refer exclusively to the software platform, digital tools, and associated web interfaces provided by the company.",
    "reason": "This is a definition clause that does not expand or alter personal data processing purposes."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k6",
    "rule_id": "R01",
    "verdict": "compliant",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "evidence": "Al-Noor Digital Services shall not be held liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the temporary unavailability of the platform due to scheduled maintenance.",
    "reason": "This liability limitation clause does not touch upon personal data consent rules."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k7",
    "rule_id": "R01",
    "verdict": "compliant",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "evidence": "Either party may terminate the service agreement with thirty days written notice, provided that all outstanding financial balances have been settled in full.",
    "reason": "This termination clause governs contractual relationships rather than personal data consent."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k8",
    "rule_id": "R11",
    "verdict": "compliant",
    "confidence": 1.0,
    "evidence": "Promotional offers and awareness materials are transmitted to personal contact channels solely upon receiving the explicit prior consent of the recipient, and every such communication shall incorporate an unambiguous, easily accessible mechanism to instantly opt out of future mailings.",
    "reason": "The clause explicitly requires prior consent and provides an opt-out mechanism for direct marketing, fully respecting the rule."
  }
]
